chunks: A group of our companions narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali, from some of his companions, from one of them (the Imams), who said:
Four ‘Umrah pilgrimages are equal to one Hajj, and the Ziyārah of the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) is equal to one ‘Umrah.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn compared to Hajj and Umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the unique status of Karbala as a spiritual center, equating the visit to Imam al-Ḥusayn’s grave with the reward of ‘Umrah, a comparison often linked to the Prophet’s statement regarding the 'Umrah of the Prophet.' The additional metric that four ‘Umrahs equal one Hajj reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the accessibility and high merit of Ziyārah as a means of attaining major pilgrimage rewards without the physical constraints of Hajj.
